text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) garnered immense 
attention as a showdown between the top 
two titans, Satono Diamond and Kitasan 
Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recalling their own Tenno Sho (Spring), 
Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio were eager 
to see how this clash of the top two would 
unfold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond was glad that the race drew 
attention as a clash between the top two 
contenders, happy to have contributed to 
the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And true ability was needed to become a 
"great Umamusume." Satono Diamond declared 
she would win the Tenno Sho (Spring) and 
make everyone acknowledge her strength!
